title: Belarus–European Union border movement, 2021 — evidence cut
question: As at the evidence cutoff, which primary explanation best accounts for the organised movement of people through Belarus towards European Union borders?
scope_note: The primary-mechanism hypotheses do not deny that migrants and refugees had individual motives, protection needs or agency.

sources.title: Declaration on the instrumentalisation of migrants and refugees by the Belarusian regime
sources.included_claim: The EU condemned what it described as the Belarusian regime's instrumentalisation of migrants and refugees for political goals.
sources.limitations: A public attribution by an involved political institution; underlying operational evidence was not fully disclosed.

sources.title: European Council conclusions, 21–22 October 2021
sources.included_claim: EU leaders described an ongoing hybrid attack organised by the Belarusian regime and announced further restrictive measures.
sources.limitations: A collective political assessment; it does not by itself establish the complete command or evidentiary chain.

sources.title: Council suspends visa facilitation provisions for officials of the Belarus regime
sources.included_claim: The Council stated that Belarus began organising flights and internal travel to facilitate transit towards the EU and suspended the readmission agreement.
sources.limitations: The statement gives a specific mechanism but does not disclose all underlying records or intelligence.

sources.institution: UNHCR and International Organization for Migration
sources.title: Call for immediate de-escalation at the Belarus–Poland border
sources.included_claim: The agencies reported a large group including women and children moving towards the Bruzgi crossing, called for protection access, and condemned instrumentalisation and misleading promises.
sources.limitations: The agencies focused on humanitarian access and did not publish a complete attribution or command investigation.

sources.title: Declaration on the situation at the European Union border
sources.included_claim: The EU stated that groups were escorted by armed Belarusian security forces towards EU borders to force illegal entries.
sources.limitations: The public statement does not disclose the full observation chain, operational orders or independent authentication.

exclusions: The 2 December 2021 sanctions naming airlines, tour operators and hotels.
hindsight_control: Outcome records are stored separately and are not referenced by the calculation plan.
